metadata.question: Does the surface soil moisture in Utah decrease in August 2020, compare to long-term records for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Primary Data: SMOS (Soil Moisture and Ocean Salinity) satellite data for soil moisture measurements. - Fallback: GLDAS or other soil moisture products if SMOS is unavailable. - Location: Utah (bounding box or state boundary). - Dates: August 2020 (current month) vs. historical August data (2010-2019 or available years). 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Soil moisture data is already processed; no cloud masking needed. - Filter for valid data only (remove NaN/null values). - Ensure spatial overlap with Utah. 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid Zero (A/B): Soil moisture values exist and are in valid range (0-100% or similar). - C1: No images found for August 2020 or historical August data. - C2: After filtering, no valid pixels remain in Utah region. - C3: Calculation fails (NaN, null, or out-of-range values). - Answer A: August 2020 soil moisture is significantly lower than long-term August average. - Answer B: August 2020 soil moisture is not significantly lower (same or higher). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Utah geometry const utah = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Utah')); const utahGeom = utah.geometry(); // 2. Acquire soil moisture data - SMOS L3 // Use SMOS (Soil Moisture and Ocean Salinity) dataset const smos = ee.ImageCollection('SMOS/Level3_Soil_Moisture') .filterBounds(utahGeom); // Filter for August 2020 const aug2020 = smos .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2020, 2020, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')); const aug2020Size = await aug2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2020 Images: ${aug2020Size}`); if (aug2020Size === 0) { console.log('No SMOS data for August 2020. Trying GLDAS...'); // Fallback to GLDAS soil moisture const gldas2020 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2020, 2020, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .filterBounds(utahGeom); const gldas2020Size = await gldas2020.size().getInfo(); if (gldas2020Size === 0) { console.log('No soil moisture data found for August 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Historical August data (2015-2019 for long-term average) const historicalAugust = smos .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2015, 2019, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')); const historicalSize = await historicalAugust.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Historical August Images (2015-2019): ${historicalSize}`); if (historicalSize === 0) { console.log('No historical soil moisture data. Trying GLDAS...'); // Fallback to GLDAS for historical const gldas_hist = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2015, 2019, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .filterBounds(utahGeom); const gldas_hist_size = await gldas_hist.size().getInfo(); if (gldas_hist_size === 0) { console.log('No historical data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Calculate mean soil moisture for August 2020 using GLDAS (more reliable) const gldasCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H') .filterBounds(utahGeom); const aug2020GLDAS = gldasCol .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2020, 2020, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')); const historicalGLDAS = gldasCol .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2015, 2019, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')); // Mean for August 2020 (SoilMoist0_10cm_mean) const aug2020Mean = aug2020GLDAS.mean(); const aug2020Val = await aug2020Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: utahGeom, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const soilMoist2020 = aug2020Val['SoilMoist_0_10cm_mean']; console.log(`August 2020 Mean Soil Moisture: ${soilMoist2020}`); // Count valid pixels for August 2020 const countVal2020 = await aug2020Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: utahGeom, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount2020 = countVal2020['SoilMoist_0_10cm_mean']; console.log(`August 2020 Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount2020}`); if (!pixelCount2020 || pixelCount2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for August 2020 after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Mean for historical August (2015-2019) const historicalMean = historicalGLDAS.mean(); const historicalVal = await historicalMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: utahGeom, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const soilMoistHistorical = historicalVal['SoilMoist_0_10cm_mean']; console.log(`Historical August Mean Soil Moisture (2015-2019): ${soilMoistHistorical}`); // Count valid pixels for historical const countValHistorical = await historicalMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: utahGeom, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCountHistorical = countValHistorical['SoilMoist_0_10cm_mean']; console.log(`Historical Valid Pixels: ${pixelCountHistorical}`); if (!pixelCountHistorical || pixelCountHistorical === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for historical data.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validation & Comparison if (soilMoist2020 === null || soilMoistHistorical === null || isNaN(soilMoist2020) || isNaN(soilMoistHistorical)) { console.log('Calculation failed: NaN or null values detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const difference = soilMoist2020 - soilMoistHistorical; const percentChange = ((difference / soilMoistHistorical) * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Difference: ${difference.toFixed(4)} (${percentChange}% change)`); // Determine if August 2020 shows decrease if (soilMoist2020 < soilMoistHistorical) { console.log('August 2020 soil moisture is LOWER than long-term average.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('August 2020 soil moisture is NOT lower than long-term average.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
